verdict.rationale: Retell's first-party docs say a single- or multi-prompt agent can connect to a remote MCP server and call that server's tools during a live voice or chat conversation. That is exactly a voice agent plugging in an MCP server as a tool source mid-call. Retell's own MCP server for building agents from Cursor or Claude is a separate server-role capability and is not credited here. Missing for 10: details on auth, tool selection or filtering, and use of multiple servers; any statement of support for node-based conversation-flow agents; independent or hands-on corroboration.
